meta.description: Conversion templates by intent_type. Standard per entity type, override in phase 2.

order.cta: Here is your order ready to send:
message_template: Hi! I'm coming from Índice IA, my order is:

quote.cta: Here is your quote request ready to send:

appointment.cta: Here is your appointment request ready to send:
message_template: Hi! I would like to schedule an appointment.

rules: Use the template that matches the entity's intent_type.
Fill in all placeholders with real data collected during the conversation.
Do not fill optional placeholders if the data was not provided.
Do not invent or assume placeholder values.
The frontend encodes the final message and builds the WhatsApp link.
You only produce the plain text message.
